newsitem.title: USA: US W. Coast gasoline prices rise with NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: US W. Coast gasoline prices rise with NYMEX rally.

text.p: U.S. West Coast spot gasoline prices advanced midday Tuesday, tracking a technically-driven rise in futures markets, traders said.
Light volume left brokers unsure about prices, which rose a notional one to two cents. Most players attended an annual industry conference in Texas.
"We don't have a very active market. It's up with the (New York Mercantile Exchange)," one broker said.
NYMEX crude, which expires Thursday, settled $1.14 higher at $22.06 a barrel. Gasoline rose 2.22 cents a gallon to 67.48 a gallon.
In Los Angeles, CARB gasoline prices rose 0.50 cents a gallon to 78/79 cents, while conventional grade rose two cents to 76/77 cents.
